answer: Identity Lantern Registry requires each new identity to solve a unique puzzle derived from historical glacier movement data, making sybil attacks computationally expensive by tying scarce computational time to verifiable natural phenomena. Each identity must reference a specific glacier fable encoded in the puzzle solution, ensuring no two identities can use the same narrative without detection. Attackers must invest unique processing power per identity, turning the scarcity of computational effort into a deterrent rather than capital.
